clause: Structured interchange + interactive/EPUB touchpoint + collaboration posture [STU-LAY-064,STU-LAY-065,STU-LAY-066,STU-LAY-067]

scope.summary: Fix that layout content is representable in structured exchange form: round-trip interchange formats (layout markup export/open for cross-version exchange, tagged-text plain-format round-trip, and structured-XML tagging with a structure tree, tag mapping to/from styles, schema validation, and image-copying export); concrete file formats/matrices owned by 14.13 (hand off, do not fork). Carry layout-side authoring of interactive objects — hyperlinks, bookmarks, buttons, MSO (MT-164), placed media (MT-161), interactive TOCs (MT-173), reflowable/fixed-layout EPUB — on the object StudioLayer and hand the interactive payload to 14.11 for export; MUST NOT define a second interactive runtime. Implement local-first review/collaboration: the native review surface (comments, annotations, markup anchored to layout positions, and a document-states/history surface beyond linear undo, 14.19/MT-149) is first-class, backed by kernel CRDT collaboration, requiring no external account/cloud; hosted/cloud capabilities (share-for-review, cloud docs/version-history, invite-to-edit, hosted fonts, generative-AI assists) are optional adapter-backed rows, never primary; file-based assignment/check-in-check-out copy-editing is native over shared local/network storage. Import of external review comments back into the layout (position-anchored) via the interchange path (14.13). This MT also records the STU-LAY-067 cross-cutting obligation (dual operator-UI + model/MCP projections, 14.16/14.17 model-visibility & parallel-workflow, headless/quiet output law 14.20, dual-audience UserManual + GUI/diagnostic/accessibility 14.22, and the sandbox->validation->PromotionGate propose-work lifecycle 14.18/MT-012) as satisfied across this plan.
acceptance_criteria: structured interchange representable; interactive payload handed to 14.11 without a second runtime; local-first CRDT review primary, hosted optional; STU-LAY-067 obligation recorded
proof_targets: structured interchange round-trip runtime; local-first CRDT review + adapter-optional test
expected_tests: live: structured-XML export round-trips layout content with style<->tag mapping + schema validation; interactive payload handed to 14.11 (no second runtime)
test: native CRDT-backed comments/annotations anchored to positions with no external account; hosted capabilities are optional adapter rows; import external review comments position-anchored

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Interchange, interactive handoff & review

risk_if_missed: No cross-version/structured interchange; interactive export forks a second runtime; collaboration forced onto cloud, violating local-first posture.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
